why: A write through a MATLAB name that errors on an object (MATLAB R2026a: `sort`, `==`, `&&`, `~=`, and `<=`, `>`, `>=` (measured in step 15 round 7b) on an object whose class defines no such method) ends no hint, the parentheses around it read through (doc 'Operator Precedence'): a later call is reached with the object or not at all, so `tidy(k)` is `Gizmo::tidy` (step 15 round 7, decisions 1 and 5). So is it after `k = [a, a]`, two objects of the class (doc 'Concatenating Objects of Different Classes': the result is of their class), and after a write a `return` follows on its own branch, which reaches no later call (decision 6's rule for what reaches).
